body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.68 (naive base rate 0.55) that: Marico FY27 consolidated EBITDA grows ≥24% YoY. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (Nov-2026): revenue +13%, India volume +10%, international +13% cc; EBITDA +27%, margin +200 bps to 18.2%. Guidance raised (second upgrade): 'mid-twenties EBITDA growth up from around 20%'; CFO: 'mid-20s about in the range of 24%, 25% on the minimum side'; revenue 'teens' growth, crossing ₹15,000 cr; margin +120–150 bps for the year. Company notes teens+ revenue growth in 8 of last 10 quarters. Reasoning: Marico has upgraded twice and frames 24–25% as a minimum, with H1 above it (EBITDA +27% in Q2). Copra/input deflation tailwind and operating leverage support it; risk is A&P reinvestment in H2. Resolution: YES if Marico's consolidated EBITDA for FY27 ÷ FY26 − 1 ≥ 24.0%, using the company's reported EBITDA (Q4 FY27 information update/press release); else screener Operating Profit FY27 vs FY26. Source: Marico Q4 FY27 information update / press release; screener.in annual P&L. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: A raised full-year guide with H1 above the new bar is delivered ~55–60% of the time for FMCG (H2 re-investment often trims it).
